description: Represents an application graph link log entry for an application graph node generated from the different logs collected by the app agents.

APIs.description: The number of allowed and denied requests to this node broken down by the deployment they went through.
APIs.title: APIs

allow.description: The number of allowed connections to this node.
allow.title: allow

deny.description: The number of denied connections to this node.
deny.title: deny

encrypted.description: The number of encrypted connections to this node.
encrypted.title: encrypted

findings.description: The findings categorized by type detected in the logs for this node.
findings.title: findings

gateways.description: The number of allowed and denied requests to this node broken down by the gateway they went through.
gateways.title: gateways

insecureEncryption.description: The number of connections to this node with insecure encryption (e.g., TLS 1.0 or 1.1).
insecureEncryption.title: insecureEncryption

logs.description: The log links from this node to other nodes in the application graph.
logs.title: logs

proxies.description: The number of allowed and denied requests to this node broken down by the deployment they went through.
proxies.title: proxies

unencrypted.description: The number of unencrypted connections to this node.
unencrypted.title: unencrypted

title: AppGraphLinkLogEntry
